correctness.rationale: The published Lagrangian degree product factors as \(2^{\binom n2}M!\prod_{j=1}^{n-1}j!/\prod_{i=1}^n(2i-1)!\). The shifted-hook formula for the staircase strict partition gives the remaining product as the degree of the minimally half-spin embedded spinor variety. Hence \(\deg L_n=2^{\binom n2}\deg S_n\), and the valuation claims follow from Legendre's formula. Independent exact-integer checks reproduce the stated initial degrees and ratios.
residual_risks: The spinor embedding must be the minimal half-spin embedding.
